Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

## Four-lane evidence register

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| **Expansion Assist** | [Claim; decision informed] | [Denominator, retained-mid population, and exclusions] | [Cohort start–end] | [Predeclared outcome window; complete / still accruing] | [Limits and exclusions specific to this claim] | [Name] | [Source, validation, release/reliability evidence] | [Explicit treatment; do not infer credit] | [Name] | [Yes / No; list missing fields] | [Not board-ready / Board-ready; owner and next action] |
| **Pricing-page path quality** | [Claim; decision informed] | [Denominator, path/population, and exclusions] | [Cohort start–end] | [Predeclared outcome window; complete / still accruing] | [Limits and exclusions specific to this claim] | [Name] | [Source, validation, release/reliability evidence] | [Explicit treatment; do not infer credit] | [Name] | [Yes / No; list missing fields] | [Not board-ready / Board-ready; owner and next action] |
| **CS auto-nudge system controls** | [Control claim; decision informed] | [Covered systems, events, or eligible control population] | [Exact coverage start–end dates] | **not applicable — continuous control coverage**; [coverage complete / gaps] | [Limits, exclusions, outages, and unobserved periods] | [Name] | [Source, control-test/release/rollback reliability evidence] | [Explicit treatment; do not infer credit] | [Name] | [Yes / No; list missing fields] | [Not board-ready / Board-ready; owner and next action] |

## Hard readiness gate — no exceptions by omission

A row may be marked **Board-ready** only when every applicable required field above is populated with traceable evidence and reviewed by its accountable owners. For customer-outcome lanes, this requires a named denominator, cohort dates, and a complete predeclared outcome window. For continuous system-control coverage, record exact coverage dates and use the stated not-applicable outcome-window value; do not represent continuous coverage as a customer-outcome window. Every lane also requires claim-specific limits and exclusions, a named source owner, source or release-reliability evidence, explicit revenue/forecast treatment, and a named final claim owner.

If any required input is missing, unvalidated, still accruing, or not traceable, set **Required inputs complete? = No** and **Readiness status = Not board-ready**. Name the gap owner and next action. A source-completeness check, preparation packet, or review meeting is not itself claim approval or a readiness decision. Do not mark the row ready based on another lane's evidence or merge lanes to conceal a gap.
